answer_1.quote: Given a user query, standing instructions, and API documentation, an agent must generate up to three API calls to fulfil the user request

answer_2.quote: We convert each API call into (function name, argument name, value) triplets, or slots, to compute the metrics and report exact match (EM), slot-wise F1, precision, and recall.

answer_4.quote: Similarly to Moghe et al. ( ), we manually annotate a sample of 100 predictions for each model and perform their qualitative analysis.
answer_4.guideline: Classify model errors into categories: semantic substitution errors, hallucinations, value formatting issues, missing arguments
